description: Capture what is currently on screen in a tab. Returns a data: URL holding a base64 PNG or JPEG. This is the visible viewport only — it does not scroll or stitch, so a long page needs the extension's full-page capture instead.

format.description: png (default, lossless) or jpeg (smaller, and the only format quality applies to)

quality.description: JPEG quality from 0 to 100; ignored for png

tabId.description: Tab to capture; uses the active tab when omitted

windowId.description: Window to capture from; uses the current window when omitted

name: session_screenshot
